review_improvement: Restores the full four-switch update matrix, isolates duplicate-code DC-cycle contamination, replaces insecure/truncated generic execution with exact artifacts and identities, and makes reboot recovery measurable.
independent_technical_reasoning: Each logical switch appears as two PEX89144 devices, so flashing only representative indices is safe only if the pair-to-physical-switch mapping is proven and stable. Firmware filenames must match each switch because a cross-flash can remove an entire downstream fabric. A new version string alone is insufficient: all eight identities, topology, negotiated links and boot/services must survive activation, while repeated DC cycling belongs to a separate testcase.
